title: Sub Organisations Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the sub organisations capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: List active children, create with slug/displayName, update displayName, deactivate by setting is_active false.

stateModel.description: Organisation rows carry parent_id, slug, display_name, is_active; the API view is flat and tenant-scoped, parent_id internal.

permissions.description: tenant.suborgs.read/create/update/delete, tenant-scoped, mapped to organisation:sub-organisations authorization scopes.

contracts.description: Org-scoped sub-organisation list/create and per-sub-org update/deactivate operations.

validation.description: Slug format and length constraints, reserved-slug rejection, and a global duplicate-slug check.

errorModel.description: invalid_body, reserved_slug, conflict, and not_found outcomes with deterministic mapping.

auditModel.description: Create/update/deactivate are audited before the database mutation; a failing audit aborts it.

readinessModel.description: Ready once the organisations table is migrated; the parent_id filter derives from the FQDN-resolved tenant.

proof.description: Unit proof of slug validation, reserved slugs, conflicts, and deactivation. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; the React headless sub-organisation journey is lineage only. Author the UI semantic model before generation.
